units.source_text: 哥哥突然喊了一声，就站在母亲床边，把脸埋在双肘里面。

en.t: My brother suddenly cried out, then stood beside Mother's bed and buried his face in the crook of both arms.

units.source_text: 后来父母去世都没哭过的哥哥——常年为了政治奔波，直至最后被送进疯人院，从未对人展示过胆怯——这样的哥哥，

en.t: That brother, who did not cry even when our parents later died, who spent years rushing about for politics until he was finally sent to a mental hospital, and who had never shown fear to anyone,

units.source_text: 此时此刻竟然啜泣起来。

en.t: that brother, at this very moment, unexpectedly began to sob.

units.source_text: 这对于情绪有点激动的母亲，也是十分意外的吧。

en.t: Even for Mother, whose emotions were somewhat stirred, this must have been completely unexpected.

units.source_text: 母亲深深的叹了一口气，欲言又止，重新躺会枕头上……

en.t: Mother let out a deep sigh, started to speak and stopped, then lay back on the pillow again...
